as_told.title: Dan Sherman and Project Preserve Destiny

plain: A man named Dan Sherman says he was part of a secret programme at the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that listens in on communications, called Project Preserve Destiny, and he describes being taken to one of its buildings in Maryland around 1991 and 1992. Sherman says the programme grew out of contact with an alien species in 1947 and began in 1960. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, who interviewed him, retells it with extra details from Sherman's book Above Black: that Sherman was trained to receive messages as tones, and that he was genetically altered as an unborn baby after his mother was abducted while pregnant. If true, it would mean a US agency was quietly using specially altered people to talk with aliens.
